area.verdict: no board design that keeps every O-2 requirement reaches 12 mm2: s1 22.12 mm2 (16 parts), std 21.32 mm2 (16 parts), merged 19.3 mm2 (15 parts), pack 0 mm2 (0 parts)

floor_mm2.note: smallest parts the function needs, all 0201 / SOT883 / X2SON: series switch Q14 1.95 + hold R174 0.70 + C174 0.78; heartbeat FET 2.02 + C175 0.78 + R176 0.70; window U19 + U20 4.78 + chain 2.11 + C170 0.78; supply gate Q18 1.95 + OR D19 2.02; approval path 0.70 (merged) or 2.73 (Q17 + R175)

std_R174_0201.leakage_direction: a leak across R174 (gate to source) lowers the gate-source resistance: the hold gets shorter and Q14 opens earlier (fail-safe). A leak from O2_G to GND would hold Q14 on; it does not depend on the resistor's case size (netclass MOHM_KEEPOUT keeps 0.30 mm to other nets). With 1 GOhm across the 0201 body the hold shortens by 1 %.
std_R174_0201.rating: voltage across R174 <= PV open-circuit voltage (3.0 V) against 25 V working; power 3.0^2 / 10 M = 0.9 uW against 50 mW (UNI-ROYAL datasheet V.9 p.4-5)

merged_approval.note: U20 is push-pull (TLV7031): at 1.5-2.7 uA its output sits at V_O2 within millivolts (VOH is specified at 3 mA: 0.35 V drop, SLVSE13 p.8). Q16 needs only to hold O2_G against R174 (PV_SW / 10 M <= 0.3 uA) after recharging C174 once; VGSth max 0.95 V is defined at 250 uA (PMZ290UNE2 p.6). The load on U20 is 9 % lower than the stage-1 pull-down R175 1 M, so the approval light and the 1.6 V corners of calc/o2_inhibit.json do not get worse.

merged_heartbeat.Q16_at_gate_1p5V: RDSon <= 0.68 Ohm at VGS 1.8 V (PMZ290UNE2 p.6); at 1.5 V the FET is far above VGSth max 0.95 V: C174 (100 nF) recharges in well under 1 us
merged_heartbeat.pin_load: CHG_DIS drives C175 + the Q10 and Q16 gates: 1.1 nF x 1.86 V = 2.0 nC per edge; with the nRF52832 standard drive (>= 0.5 mA) the edge takes <= 4 us (inside the 10 us pulse); energy C V^2 f = 38.0 nW at 10 Hz

release_after_last_pulse_s.note: Q14 opens when |VGS| decays below its threshold: the stage-0 'fault response' of the O-2 hold

rules_unchanged: pulse CHG_DIS only in software (never PPI, a timer or PWM), 10 us at 10 Hz
only while CHG_PG_N is high (no head) and the last NTC reading is inside 0-45 C (0.5 K margin); stop on any out-of-window reading
never during an NTC reading (Q10 pulls the NTC node low for 10 us)
SHELF in System OFF does not harvest with a healthy cell; below VBAT_OK falling (3.31 V) the O-2 takes over (>= 711 lx)

merged_side_effect_A_CHG_DIS.reading: with R146 1 M the approval edge lifts the Q10 gate to the pin clamp (about 0.55 V) for about 1 ms: a Q10 with a low threshold pulls the NTC node down, U20 reads 'hot' and withdraws the approval: chatter. With R146 10 k the gate stays below 0.25 V for about 10 us: at most one extra comparator cycle at the moment of approval. The glitch can only follow a genuine approval (U19 and U20 both true), so it cannot create one outside the window; it must be shown in SIM-03.
merged_side_effect_A_CHG_DIS.change: R146 1 M -> 10 k 0201 (C473048, already in the BOM) with SB_O2=merged: 186 uA from the MCU only while CHG_DIS is held high (charge stop at 41 C skin, head attached)

merged_side_effect_B_U20_output.abs_max: TLV703x OUT: VEE - 0.3 V .. VCC + 0.3 V (SLVSE13 p.6). While the O-2 is unpowered the heartbeat forward-biases the output clamp of U20 by one diode drop (about 0.4 V above its VCC pin) at the microampere level, 10 us at 10 Hz. TI limits the INPUT pins to 10 mA in this condition and gives no current limit for OUT: the letter of the table is exceeded by about 0.1 V. Open question for TI (or a bench check) before SB_O2=merged is used.

merged_verdict.status: calculated; NOT in the baseline: two effects that the stage-1 circuit does not have (sections 3.3, 3.4) need SIM-03 and a maker's answer

requirements_check.MCU off, cell flat (VBAT_OK low), in win: U19 / U20 approve -> O2_HB 0.91 x V_O2 -> Q16 on -> Q14 on (as stage 1 through Q17)
requirements_check.MCU off, cell flat, out of window or too: U20 low or unpowered -> R176 holds O2_HB at 0 V -> Q14 off
requirements_check.MCU in reset / halted / off at a healthy: no heartbeat, O-2 unpowered -> Q14 off within the hold (0.64-1.67 s)
requirements_check.firmware running: heartbeat pulses -> Q16 -> Q14 on; stop on any out-of-window reading
requirements_check.dark load: 0 (PV_SW = 0 V); heartbeat about 1 uW only while the firmware wants PV charging
requirements_check.no oscillation with Q1 / Q8: unchanged: the O-2 only opens Q14

facts.p.1: temperature protection with an external NTC on a dedicated pin; low temperature charge inhibition -40..+10 C and high temperature charge inhibition +40..+85 C in 1 C steps, accuracy +-3 C with the NTC of Table 6; 0 V battery charge enabled or inhibited (option); HSNT-8(1616); 2.5 uA typ / 5.0 uA max operating, 0.5 uA max in overdischarge
facts.p.6 Table 6: catalogue products S-82D1AAI / AAJ / AAK / AAL-A8T2U7: THCD 60 C, THC 45 C, TLC 0 C, TLCD -20 C, hysteresis 5 C, sampling wait 512 ms, count 2, NTC 10 k +-1 % B 3380 K +-1 %
facts.p.9: operation voltage VDD-VSS 1.5-6.0 V; 0 V battery charge inhibition battery voltage V0INH 0.9 / 1.2 / 1.5 V (min / typ / max)
facts.p.21: overdischarge status below VDL (2.0-3.0 V); with a charger connected it is released at VDL or VDU
facts.p.22-23: charge overcurrent detection and the CTL input do not function in the overdischarge status
facts.p.24: 'carries out intermittent operation in the normal status': the NTC is sampled for 4 ms after each sampling wait time; the charge FET is turned off in the charge-inhibit statuses only while the VM pin is at or below 3 mV typ. (charger connected)
facts.p.25: 0 V battery charge inhibited: below V0INH the charge FET gate is fixed to EB-: no charging

coverage_by_cell_voltage.pv_current: not specified (below the 1.5 V operation voltage)

coverage_by_cell_voltage.cell_V: 1.5 V to VDL (2.0-3.0 V), overdischarge status

coverage_by_cell_voltage.status: unknown: maker's answer needed (this is the deeply discharged case of BASELINE 13.2)

coverage_by_cell_voltage.pv_current: charge FET off outside TLC..THC after 2 samples (about 1 s)
coverage_by_cell_voltage.status: meets O-2 within +-3 C: a guaranteed 0-45 C window needs TLC 3 C and THC 42 C (1 C steps exist; not catalogue values)

other_points: the catalogue parts are trimmed for a 10 k B 3380 K NTC; the pack NTC of BASELINE 5.2 is B 3950 K (BQ25170 TS, board ladder): the PCM needs its own NTC on its own pin (a second NTC in the capsule) or a custom trim

in a charge-inhibit status the charge FET is off while VM <= 3 mV: the band's small discharge current then flows through the FET's body diode (about 0.5 V below the cell): the rail can fall below VBAT_OK falling (3.31 V) whenever the cell is below 0 C or above 45 C (my reading of p.24, 7.2 / 7.3; to be confirmed with the maker)
Iq 2.5 / 5.0 uA is inside the pack's 6 uA limit (BASELINE 5.2)
Nisshinbo NB7130 / R5449 also list a temperature protection; their datasheets could not be downloaded (HTML answer on 2026-11-14) and are not read: unknown
pack_pcm_S82D1A.verdict: a real PCM IC with a 0 / 45 C charge-temperature cut-off exists (ABLIC S-82D1A). Its datasheet does not state that the cut-off works for a deeply discharged cell (1.5 V to VDL), so the board O-2 cannot be dropped on the datasheet alone: reserve 3 stays open until the pack maker or ABLIC answers in writing
